) (OTCQX: CURLF) ("Curaleaf" or the "Company"), a leading international provider of consumer cannabis products, today announced the opening of a new dispensary in Florida: Curaleaf North Fort Myers in Southwest Florida. The new location increases the Company's Florida store total to 82 dispensaries and its nationwide footprint to 192 stores.

The new store brings added convenience to patients across Southwest Florida. Located at 6350 Bayshore Rd, North Fort Myers, FL 33917, Curaleaf North Fort Myers sits along Bayshore Road (State Road 78), the route that connects North Fort Myers with Interstate 75 and Cape Coral.

Curaleaf North Fort Myers offers a broad range of products, including Curaleaf's Florida-exclusive Reef flower, Dark Heart ultra-premium flower, FIND flower, Anthem pre-rolls, and the Select Briq 2 all-in-one vape, giving medical patients across Lee County expanded access to trusted brands close to home.

"Florida's patient community keeps growing, and each store we add is another way to show up for the patients who rely on us," said Boris Jordan, Chairman and CEO of Curaleaf. "Our new North Fort Myers location means patients across Lee County can have more convenient access to the consistent care and quality products they need."

Curaleaf North Fort Myers will open with a soft opening on Tuesday, November 24, and a grand opening celebration on Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28. The event will feature brand activations, in-store promotions, and giveaways including custom-branded hats and bags, while supplies last. Curaleaf North Fort Myers will operate Monday through Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 8:30 P.M. ET, and Sunday from 10:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M. ET.
